correctness.rationale: The positive-diagonal class identity follows by cancelling the common factor gamma in the defining differential inequality. The source coefficient estimate then gives |a_n|+|b_n|<=4/(n+1). Combining this with the standard bounded-harmonic Schwarz bound lambda_f(0)>=pi/(4M) yields an exact line-segment lower bound a-S(r). The series S is strictly increasing, has the stated elementary sum, and has a unique crossing with a. The covering radius is the exact integral of a-S, hence positive, and the large-M constants follow from the first nonzero Taylor terms.
